Dated 25/07/2014 And Etc.
 This Writ Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This
Day, P.S.Dinesh Kumar J., Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

Heard Shri.M.V.Charati, learned Advocate for BDA, Shri. Jeevan J. Neeralgi, learned AGA for State and Shri.P.V.Chandrashekar, learned Advocate appearing on behalf of Smt.D.J.Rakshitha for respondent 2(A).

2. Shri.Chandrashekar, learned advocate for respondent No.2 submits that petitioner desires to avail the compensation in the form of sites under 40:60 Scheme enumerated in the preliminary notification and desires to withdraw the challenge to the acquisition.

Same is stated in paragraphs 4,
5 and 6 of the affidavit filed by Shri.Chikkanarasimhaiah, legal representative of deceased respondent No.2.
3.
Shri.Charati for BDA submitted that if the writ petition is withdrawn, BDA would consider petitioner's application and dispose of the same.

4. In view of the above, we proceed to pass the following:
ORDER (1) Writ appeal is disposed of.
is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to petitioner to file representation within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.

(3) BDA shall consider the petitioner's application for grant of incentive sites in 40:60 Scheme within an outer limit of six months from the date of receipt of copy of this order in accordance with law.
